exercises.title: Two-sale moving average
concepts: ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
exercises.problemHtml:
For every sale return seller, sold_on, amount, moving_avg2 — the average of this sale and the seller's previous one (1 decimal). Order by seller, sold_on.

Sample table (chapter 8)

sale (id PK, region, seller, amount numeric(10,2), sold_on date) — the 8 rows of lesson 8.1
 1 North Alice 100 2026-01-05 · 2 North Alice 150 2026-02-10 · 3 North Bob 200 2026-01-20 · 4 North Bob 150 2026-03-01
 5 South Carol 300 2026-01-15 · 6 South Carol 250 2026-02-20 · 7 South Dave 180 2026-02-05 · 8 South Dave 220 2026-03-10

Requirements

  • Frame ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
  • The first sale of a seller averages over itself only.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Với mọi giao dịch trả về seller, sold_on, amount, moving_avg2 — trung bình của giao dịch này và giao dịch trước đó của người bán (1 chữ số). Sắp theo seller, sold_on.

Bảng mẫu (chương 8)

sale (id PK, region, seller, amount numeric(10,2), sold_on date) — the 8 rows of lesson 8.1
 1 North Alice 100 2026-01-05 · 2 North Alice 150 2026-02-10 · 3 North Bob 200 2026-01-20 · 4 North Bob 150 2026-03-01
 5 South Carol 300 2026-01-15 · 6 South Carol 250 2026-02-20 · 7 South Dave 180 2026-02-05 · 8 South Dave 220 2026-03-10

Yêu cầu

  • Khung ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
  • Giao dịch đầu của mỗi người chỉ lấy trung bình trên chính nó.

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT seller, sold_on, amount,
       round(avg(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY seller ORDER BY sold_on
                               ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS moving_avg2
FROM sale
ORDER BY seller, sold_on;

exercises.title: Top and bottom of the region: the LAST_VALUE trap
exercises.problemHtml:
For every sale return region, seller, amount, top_amount, bottom_amount — the largest and the smallest amount of its region. Order by region, amount descending, seller.

Sample table (chapter 8)

sale (id PK, region, seller, amount numeric(10,2), sold_on date) — the 8 rows of lesson 8.1
 1 North Alice 100 2026-01-05 · 2 North Alice 150 2026-02-10 · 3 North Bob 200 2026-01-20 · 4 North Bob 150 2026-03-01
 5 South Carol 300 2026-01-15 · 6 South Carol 250 2026-02-20 · 7 South Dave 180 2026-02-05 · 8 South Dave 220 2026-03-10

Requirements

  • first_value(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC) for the top.
  • last_value needs the frame ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING.

exercises.title: Each order inside its customer's history
concepts: running total with a unique order
exercises.problemHtml:
For every paid or shipped order return customer_id, order_id, total, customer_total, pct, cum_total, nth: the order total (Σ qty × unit_price), the customer's total over those orders, this order's share in % (1 decimal), the customer's cumulative total in time order, and the order's position in that history (1 = first). Order by customer_id, created_at.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • Order totals in a CTE first (one row per order).
  • cum_total: ORDER BY created_at, order_id with a ROWS frame (unique order).

order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)

Đúng 8 bảng của Lab 1–9 (ở schema public thay vì shop); dữ liệu là một lát nhỏ của dữ liệu lab — cùng cây danh mục, cùng id/SKU/giá sản phẩm. Mọi id là GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: bỏ cột id khi INSERT. Thời gian là timestamptz hiển thị theo giờ Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Script đầy đủ: tab ctshop.sql.

WITH t AS (
  SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.customer_id, o.created_at, sum(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  GROUP BY o.id, o.customer_id, o.created_at
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, total,
       sum(total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id)                                   AS customer_total,
       round(100.0 * total / sum(total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 1)         AS pct,
       sum(total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at, order_id
                        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)           AS cum_total,
       row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at, order_id)   AS nth
FROM t
ORDER BY customer_id, created_at;

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The same partition can host different frames: no ORDER BY ⇒ the whole partition, ORDER BY + ROWS ⇒ a growing prefix. Making the ORDER BY unique (created_at, order_id) is what makes running totals reproducible.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Cùng một phần có thể dùng khung khác nhau: không ORDER BY ⇒ cả phần, ORDER BY + ROWS ⇒ một đoạn đầu lớn dần. Làm ORDER BY duy nhất (created_at, order_id) mới khiến tổng dồn lặp lại được.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);
